year.shelter: It rests in a burrow in the river bank. The burrow stays cool and calm.
year.young: It lays two tiny eggs in a burrow in the river bank. The babies hatch, drink milk and stay inside until they can swim.

text.title: Platypus
text.menu_sub: a shy river swimmer with a duck bill
text.menu_wild: Swim and dive in the river. Scoop food from the mud!
text.night_hint: It is dark and quiet. You can still swim and rest in your burrow.
text.too_exposed: You are out in the open. Find the river or your burrow to feel safe.
text.sheltered: You are safe in your cool burrow. The water hums nearby.
text.hungry: You are hungry. Slip into the water and sift for small river food.
text.no_food: No food here. Try the soft mud on the river bottom.
text.rain_start: Rain patters on the river. The water is cool and fresh.
text.rain_stop: The rain has stopped. The river is calm again.
text.intro_safe: You are a platypus. You glide in the river and rest in your bank burrow.
text.intro_survival: You are a platypus. Find food on the river bottom and keep your burrow safe.
text.intro_wild: You are a wild platypus. Dive, sift the mud and swim home to your burrow.
text.dig: Digging... Your burrow keeps you cool and calm.
text.about_looks: Dark brown fur with a pale belly, a wide flat bill like a duck, a broad flat furry tail and webbed front feet for swimming.
text.about_food: It sifts the river bottom for tiny water animals like shrimp, caddisfly babies and worms.
text.about_home: It lives by rivers and rainforest streams. It rests in a cool burrow dug into the river bank.
text.about_winter: It stays awake all year. It swims and finds food even in cold months.
text.about_young: It lays two tiny eggs in a burrow in the bank. The babies hatch, drink milk and stay inside until they can swim.
text.about_fact: It is a mammal that lays eggs. Its bill feels the tiny wiggles of small animals hiding in the mud.
